named-native-query.name: EsqOrgJpa.customOrg
named-native-query.query: SELECT opr_par_name AS "name", opr_value AS "value" FROM esq_org_par WHERE opr_org_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint)

named-native-query.name: EsqUsrJpa.customUsr
named-native-query.query: SELECT upr_par_name AS "name", upr_value AS "value" FROM esq_usr_par WHERE upr_usr_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint)

named-native-query.name: EsqUsrJpa.updateCustomUsr
named-native-query.query: UPDATE esq_usr_par SET upr_value = :value ,upr_crl_id = :correlationId ,upr_req_id = :requestId ,upr_uid = :uid WHERE upr_usr_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint) AND upr_par_name = :name

named-native-query.name: EsqOrgJpa.updateCustomOrg
named-native-query.query: UPDATE esq_org_par SET opr_value = :value ,opr_crl_id = :correlationId ,opr_req_id = :requestId ,opr_uid = :uid WHERE opr_org_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint) AND opr_par_name = :name
